---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a command, a feature, or an idea from other presentation software
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What would you like Anne's Stage to do?**
A clear description of the feature or command.

**Where should it live?**
Tab and group (for example *Animations ▸ Advanced Animation*), or *not in tabs*. Suggest a command id if you like (see docs/COMMANDS-PLAN.md for the naming conventions).

**Where does the idea come from?**
If another program has it, name the program and version (nominative use only) and describe the behavior in your own words. Please do not paste text, images or help content from proprietary software.

**Why is it useful?**
The situation where you would use it.

**Platforms**
- [ ] Android
- [ ] iOS / iPadOS
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Linux (including Raspberry Pi)
- [ ] ChromeOS
- [ ] Web

**Anything else?**
Mock-ups, links to public specifications, or related issues.
